modmenu.descriptionTranslation.rss-autom: Auto send messages at intervals and auto-reply mod with command support
config.auto-messenger.title: RS's AutoMessage Settings
config.auto-messenger.enable_scheduled.d: Automatically send all messages in list at set intervals
config.auto-messenger.send_on_join.desc: Send all messages immediately when joining a server
config.auto-messenger.send_interval.desc: Interval between sends in milliseconds (1000ms = 1s, min 5000ms recommended)
config.auto-messenger.enable_loop.desc: Repeat sending messages when interval reached (disable to send once only)
config.auto-messenger.scheduled_list.des: All messages sent at once when interval reached. Format: content|msg (chat) or content|cmd (command, auto adds /)
config.auto-messenger.enable_autoreply.d: Auto reply when trigger keywords are detected
config.auto-messenger.trigger_keywords.d: Auto reply when message contains any of these keywords (case insensitive)
config.auto-messenger.reply_message.desc: Message to send when triggered (supports commands starting with /)
config.auto-messenger.reply_cooldown.des: Minimum interval between auto replies in milliseconds (anti-spam)
config.auto-messenger.show_countdown.des: Display countdown timer at bottom left (requires game restart)
